calculation: Each Ahem letter and space advances 10px. The longest unbreakable word has two letters (20px) and the one-line text is 4*20px + 3*10px = 110px. grid-template-areas defines a two-column explicit grid; the second area-created explicit track is sized by grid-auto-columns because grid-template-columns sizes only the first track. CSS Grid fit-content() uses max(auto minimum, min(limit, max-content)); with a 40px limit and a 20px minimum, that track is 40px.
